an8.55:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho ujjayo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an8.55:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ujjayo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.55:1.4: tesaṃ no bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu yenamhākaṃ assu dhammā diṭṭhadhammahitāya diṭṭhadhammasukhāya samparāyahitāya samparāyasukhāyāti.
an8.55:2.1: cattārome brāhmaṇa, dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.55:3.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto yena kammaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti
an8.55:3.3: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena,
an8.55:3.4: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātunti.
an8.55:4.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā
an8.55:4.4: kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ na corā hareyyuṃ na aggi ḍaheyya na udakaṃ vaheyya na appiyā dāyādā hareyyunti.
an8.55:5.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati. tatra ye te honti gahapati vā gahapatiputtā vā daharā vā vuddhasīlino vuddhā vā vuddhasīlino saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā, tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, yathārūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati. yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati.
an8.55:6.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto āyaṃ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayaṃ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī’ti.
an8.55:6.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ettakena vā ottaṃ ettakena vā unnatanti.
an8.55:6.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayaṃ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ, evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.55:6.5: sacāyaṃ brāhmaṇa, kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘udumbarakhādikaṃ vāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge bādatī’ti.
an8.55:6.6: sace panāyaṃ brāhmaṇa, kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘ajaddhumārikaṃ cāyaṃ kulaputto marissatī’ti.
an8.55:6.7: yato ca kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa, kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī ti,
an8.55:7.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa, bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:7.2: itthidhutto hoti surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.55:7.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni, tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca na sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya, evaṃ tassa brāhmaṇa, mahato taḷākassa parihāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā. no vuddhi.
an8.55:7.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:7.5: itthidhutto surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.55:8.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa, bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:8.2: na itthidhutto hoti na surādhutto na akkhadhutto kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.55:8.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni, tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, devo ca sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya, evaṃ hi tassa brāhmaṇa, mahato taḷākassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā. no parihāni.
an8.55:8.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:9.1: ime kho brāhmaṇa, cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.55:10.1: cattāro me brāhmaṇa, dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya.
an8.55:10.5: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an8.55:10.6: iti’pi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
an8.55:11.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmeraya majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti,
an8.55:12.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggārato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato,
an8.55:13.2: idha brāhmaṇa, kulaputto paññavā hoti …pe… sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.55:14.1: ime kho brāhmaṇa, cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāyāti.
